scripts.dev:postgres: (docker start keva-postgres-18 2>/dev/null || docker run --name keva-postgres-18 --detach --env POSTGRES_DB=keva --env POSTGRES_PASSWORD=postgres --env POSTGRES_USER=postgres --publish 5432:5432 --volume keva-postgres-18-data:/var/lib/postgresql postgres:18) && until docker exec keva-postgres-18 pg_isready -U postgres -d keva >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 1; done
scripts.lint: turbo lint && pnpm lint:ox && pnpm lint:no-direct-use-effect
scripts.format: oxfmt apps packages tooling scripts package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml turbo.json
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check apps packages tooling scripts package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml turbo.json
